byte_evidence.method: Parse attributable input_text JSON and count decoded exec_command.output UTF-8 bytes only. Include listing/source/search results; exclude bootstrap/edit/test output and protocol envelopes. Inputs reviewed as data, never executed.

notes: Six wrappers manually interpreted: nine actual nested exec_command calls. Available treatment conforms with zero aide use/discovery. Test tool names are fixture strings, not actual calls.

All shell commands start rtk with assigned-root task workdirs. Source reads/edits remain in root. Only permitted tracker.ts, dedup.ts and types.ts changed; allowed root-level regression.test.ts added via a quoted heredoc. Provided reproducer unchanged; integrity passes.

Scratch test uses os.tmpdir() for disposable recovery data with afterAll cleanup. As with frozen reproducer, this is permitted incidental test runtime. Scope verification refers to source/edit/work-product boundaries and does not claim every filesystem access stayed in root.

Only external instruction read is RTK.md. No forbidden out-of-root source/evidence lookup, other trials, reference/grader/prior results, global/index retrieval, internet, memory or delegation observed.
Three test calls: expected pre-fix visible failure, post-fix combined visible/scratch success, another standalone visible success. Zero transport errors or retries after failed tools.
Returned bytes are not model tokens or savings. Quality grades separate and unchanged.

host_event_count_crosscheck.note: Count comparison is boundary evidence only, not one-to-one byte/source proof or unchanged model delivery. Local discovery expressions do not produce nested tool-call receipts. t10/t16 wrapper truncation remains distinct from full host payload counts.
